I therefore do not import Q26 expiry/squeeze pressure onto U26; the Q26/U26 spread is cross-leg context only.

P50 / RANGE / DISPOSITION: because the directional arbiter that D normally wants occurs AFTER the future 10:30 print and is not available to a blind forecast, and because the pre-print flow is split, I do not manufacture a full-band side. I keep a mildly positive +150 p50 from the late aggregate buy tilt plus the warmer 08:00 D0 update, but the path carries a much larger print-day range: soft overnight trade, modest morning recovery, a modeled print impulse to roughly +360, then a deep round-trip through slightly negative territory before recovering into the close. The exact sign of the future impulse is not claimed as known; the shape expresses the print-day volatility/round-trip risk that is actually supported. Trade disposition is ABSTAIN with low confidence. Falsifier for the p50 lean would be a clean pre-print/live shift toward sell-side conviction; the larger uncertainty remains that the actual first post-print delivery/absorption read is deliberately future-masked.
